title: 第十章凶手要逃！
slug: 看见罪犯词条我成了警局团宠
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“转移证据更是无稽之谈。”

“多半是他们挖到了学生物用的骷髅道具了，你别一惊一乍的。”

至于学生物用的骷髅道具是怎么到操场上去的，那你就别管那么多。

对于李班主任给出的解释，班上的同学闻言都点了点头。

这是当下最合情合理的解释。

好好的学校，怎么可能会在大操场突然冒出一具尸体。

还转移罪证，这是直接从校园快进了悬疑剧场。

谁能相信。

站在讲台之上，李班主任看向黎雾的目光充满复杂。

之前黎雾有点社恐，不喜欢和班上同学交流。

没想到现在被刺激得，直接从社恐进化成了幻想症。

这么年轻的姑娘，哎！

反正李班主任和班上的同学无论怎么说，都不相信黎雾说的操场上有尸体。

甚至有同学贴心地把教室门当着黎雾的面帮她关上。

生怕她做出什么过激举动。

“李老师，我说的是真的。”

“我刚刚真的看到了。”

黎雾没办法了，当着所有人的面，直接拿出手机，快速拨通陆云铮的电话，急切道：

“陆警官，出事了。”

“我在我们学校操场上发现了一具尸体，现在有人正在转移尸体。”

“他们打算用运渣车把尸体给运出去。”

正说话间

黎雾抬眼，就看见操场中的那辆运渣车正在缓缓启动，目的地直朝学校大门而去。

随着运渣车的启动，车辆后面的渣土石块开始滚动。

在【明亮的双眼加持下】，黎雾眼神清晰地在那堆石块中看到了一个骷髅头。

骷髅头黑黝黝的眼眶，好似正在和她对视。

明明站在人多的教室里，黎雾的身上，却骤然浮现出一层汗水。

警局之中

陆云铮没有想到自己会再次接到黎雾的电话。

或者说，他很震惊，黎雾这个社恐居然也会主动打电话联系人。

这个时候她应该是在上课才对。

害怕出什么事，陆云铮没有犹豫，立即点击接听。

没曾想听到的是如此劲爆的消息。

云城一中翻新操场，居然翻出了一具尸体，现在还有人正在偷偷转移罪证。

没有丝毫犹豫怀疑，陆云铮相信了黎雾的话，立即决定道：

"The transfer of evidence is even more nonsense."

"They probably dug up skeleton props for studying biology. Don't be surprised."

As for how the skull props used for studying biology got to the playground, then don't worry about it.

Regarding the explanation given by class teacher Li, the students in the class all nodded.

This is the most reasonable explanation at the moment.

How could a good school suddenly have a body appear in the playground?

Incriminating evidence was also transferred, which was fast forwarded directly from the campus to the suspense theater.

Who can believe it.

Standing on the podium, head teacher Li looked at Li Wu with complicated eyes.

Li Wu was a bit socially anxious before and didn't like communicating with his classmates.

Unexpectedly, I was so stimulated that my social anxiety evolved directly into hallucinations.

Such a young girl, hey!

Anyway, no matter what class teacher Li and his classmates said, they didn't believe Li Wu's statement that there were corpses on the playground.

Some classmates even thoughtfully closed the classroom door in front of Li Wu.

He was afraid that she would do something drastic.

"Teacher Li, what I said is true."

"I just really saw it."

Li Wu had no choice but to take out his cell phone in front of everyone, quickly dialed Lu Yunzheng's number, and said urgently:

"Officer Lu, something happened."

"I found a body in our school playground and someone is moving the body now."

"They plan to use a slag truck to transport the body out."

While talking

Li Wu raised his eyes and saw that the slag truck in the playground was slowly starting, heading straight towards the school gate.

As the slag truck started, the dirt and rocks behind the vehicle began to roll.

With [blessed by bright eyes], Li Wu clearly saw a skull among the pile of stones.

The dark eyes of the skull seemed to be staring at her.

Although he was standing in a crowded classroom, a layer of sweat suddenly appeared on Li Wu's body.

In the police station

Lu Yunzheng did not expect that he would receive a call from Li Wu again.

In other words, he was shocked that Li Wu, a social worker, would actually take the initiative to call people.

She should be in class at this time.

Afraid of something happening, Lu Yunzheng immediately clicked to answer the call without hesitation.

I never expected to hear such exciting news.

Yuncheng No. 1 Middle School was renovating the playground, and a body was found. Now someone is secretly transferring evidence.

Without any hesitation or doubt, Lu Yunzheng believed Li Wu's words and immediately decided:
